paper_id: Yang et al. - 2014 - Demo high-precision RFID tracking using COTS devies
title: Demo: High-Precision RFID Tracking Using COTS Devices
motivation: 机器人装配线需要厘米级甚至毫米级定位精度
problem_framing: 从带噪声的相位测量反推标签位置
key_insight: 利用天线与标签相对运动生成虚拟阵列,通过差分消除硬件差异项
method_signature: DAH hologram-based 动态轨迹恢复
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: Naive hologram给出不分明结果,存在大范围高值连续区域
evidence_for_taste: phase measurement as a Gaussian random variable
which means that the tag diversity is hard to infer
cannot give distinctive result about the initial position
The error can be reduced to within 10mm
thinking_moves: 把天线移动建模为虚拟阵列以获得多视角观测
从误差分析反推方法设计:先验证噪声分布再建模
分层递进:先简化可控场景,再放松假设推广
cites_own_work: Tagoram: Real-time tracking of mobile rfid tags to high precision using COTS devices
